name: Ball Weevil
abilities: Plasma ball generation - spits sticky green plasma spheres that explode on impact or on command
Matter and energy absorption - balls grow as they roll, and bigger balls make bigger explosions
Plasma whips and ropes - streams of plasma that tie up foes (momentarily held a Tetramand)
Rolls on top of his plasma balls for speed, even across water (they float)
Enhanced jumping, agility, flips and wall scaling
Surprising strength and durability for his size (stopped his own giant rolling ball; survives his own explosions)
weaknesses: Plasma is neutralised by Terroranchula webs and useless against species that withstand it (Arburian Pelarotas)
Can be hurt by his own balls if they are reflected back, and can get stuck in his own plasma
Small size is a disadvantage against large opponents such as Terroranchula, which trapped him in its web
summary: A tiny yellow beetle-like alien that spits sticky plasma balls which snowball up anything they roll over and then blow up on command.
traits: Omnitrix symbol sits on a green-and-white neck brace
Concept names Turd Burglar and Collectiball; named by Matt Wayne
Design inspired by Pokemon; powers resemble Katamari Damacy
Matt Wayne's and Joe Kelly's favourite Omniverse alien
Comes from the same (unnamed) planet as The Worst
notableFeats: Defeated Princess Looma with Julie's help (Rules of Engagement)
Beat Computron's minions while de-aged to 11 (Arrested Development)
Held off Tyrannopede until Khyber's pet switched to Terroranchula (Showdown: Part 1)
Escaped the brainwashed Revonnahganders (While You Were Away)
Defeated Swift and Leander of the Rooters (The Rooters of All Evil)
Took down a Way Bad (Weapon XI: Part 2)

appearances.designNotes: Small yellow insect with four stick legs, black eyes with green pupils, beak and a big forked antenna; Omnitrix symbol on a green/white neck brace.

image.label: OV
image.notes: Infobox render (transparent) but tiny at 177x286. Larger official poses with plasma balls: 'Pose of Ball Weevil.png' (339x543) and 'Ball Weevil Pose - Mirrored.png' (1583x2048, horizontally flipped).

scoring.rationale: Snowballing explosive plasma is a decent gimmick - it beat Looma, two Rooters and a Way Bad - and riding the balls gives him speed, water-crossing and wall-scaling mobility. But he is tiny, only modestly tough, his plasma is countered by webs and Pelarotas, and it can backfire on him.

notes: Arrested Development use is wiki-labelled 'by 11-year-old Ben' - present-day Ben de-aged by Billy Billions' ray, not a flashback; recorded as ben-11-ov per the wiki label.
Species and home planet are unknown on the wiki (species page 'Ball Weevil's Species'); Derrick J. Wyatt says he shares a planet with The Worst.
Never locked in the Omnitrix (Derrick J. Wyatt). Sometimes spelled 'Ballweevil' in credits/OV brief.
Online/mobile games and comics (Down in the Dumps, Super Secret Crisis War!) not counted.
